plan.reason: Repeated physical-core monitoring found no sustained quiet interval; prior noisy results are retained and not reused for this inference.
plan.method: 192 balanced randomized three-arm rounds; all six permutations per six-round block, independently shuffled. Moving interference is handled by resampling complete six-round blocks; CPU affinity is fixed within the run.
plan.acceptance: Every original ratio-of-medians CPU/wall comparison AND every upper confidence bound on the ratio of mean CPU/wall times must be <= 5%. All complete results retained; no automatic retry on failure.
plan.cpu_selection: Highest minimum sibling idle percentage over five seconds among allowed physical cores; no idle threshold. No owned builds/tests/scans allowed during measurement.

confidence_method: Percentile bootstrap of 32 complete six-round blocks; simultaneous family alpha 0.05 across eight CPU/wall comparisons.
